scope.claim_boundary: This plan authorizes only staged downloads and validation. It does not mark any learned execution gate ready.

required_recheck: allocation and one forward pass succeed

compatibility_risks: Python 3.13 model-specific dependency support must be smoke-tested
Transformers audio imports may require NumPy long and ulong aliases
flash-attn is installed but current CUDA is unavailable

existing_snapshots.role: audio event proposal and CLAP cross-check, not audio-text retrieval

network.credential_policy: Proxy and authentication values are runtime-only and must not be stored in artifacts.

retrieval.revision_policy: Pin repository tokenizer, Whisper chunks, configuration and index hashes.
retrieval.input: query text and pinned Whisper text chunks
retrieval.output: ranked speech segment IDs and scores
retrieval.limitation: Lexical control; inherits ASR errors and does not measure semantic audio retrieval.
retrieval.fallback: Repository deterministic token-overlap retrieval, labeled non-BM25 and non-learned.

retrieval.license_verification: Official Hugging Face API metadata verified 2026-09-11; archive model card before download.
retrieval.input: sampled RGB frames and query text
retrieval.output: normalized visual and text embeddings with similarity score
retrieval.resource: Expected 2-4 GB working RAM or VRAM plus batch buffers; measure at smoke test.
retrieval.scientific_role: Primary learned visual retrieval versus handcrafted and lexical controls.
retrieval.limitation: Frame pooling is not native temporal reasoning.
retrieval.fallback: Handcrafted visual routing remains diagnostic only; learned retrieval gate is false.

retrieval.license_verification: Official Hugging Face API metadata verified 2026-09-11; archive model card before download.
retrieval.output: normalized audio and text embeddings with similarity score
retrieval.resource: Expected 2-4 GB working RAM or VRAM; measure at smoke test.
retrieval.limitation: Requires domain and segment-duration calibration; AST remains only an event-label cross-check.
retrieval.fallback: AST-label lexical search, explicitly non-learned open-vocabulary retrieval; learned audio gate is false.

retrieval.revision_policy: Hash code, feature schema, optimizer, seed, training family IDs, labels and learned coefficients.
retrieval.input: BM25, SigLIP2 and CLAP scores/ranks plus modality-availability features
retrieval.scientific_role: Actually learned score fusion without another large foundation model.
retrieval.limitation: Not admissible until a disjoint non-evaluation training split exists.
retrieval.fallback: Equal-weight reciprocal-rank fusion with learned=false; LEARNED_RETRIEVAL_READY remains false.

generation.license_verification: Official Hugging Face API metadata and included LICENSE verified 2026-09-11.
generation.output: strict answer, assertions, claim handles, citations and insufficiency JSON
generation.resource: Roughly 4-8 GB working RAM depending dtype/context; GPU preferred but CPU smoke is possible.
generation.scientific_role: Minimal local learned grounded generator and shared controller backbone.
generation.limitation: Textualized evidence is not native audiovisual generation and the small model may be weak.
generation.fallback: Versioned API model under API provenance rules; deterministic generator is protocol control only.

generation.license_verification: Official Hugging Face API metadata verified 2026-09-11; archive model card before download.
generation.input: sampled video frames and question, optionally derived transcript/event text
generation.output: structured answer and citations where observations can be addressed
generation.resource: Target at least 16 GB usable GPU for practical runs; CPU smoke only on current host.
generation.limitation: Does not prove native ambient-audio understanding; any derived audio text must be disclosed.
generation.fallback: Omit row; retain deterministic direct-context protocol probe as learned=false.

agents.policy: Reactive query formulation, tool observation and bounded recovery.
agents.budget_contract: Identical backend, top-k, max steps, tool costs and context cap to sufficiency controller.
agents.limitation: One backbone and one prompt family do not establish model diversity.

agents.policy: Explicit public claim-slot coverage, missing modality/hop/cause, channel checks, supported stop or justified abstention.
agents.budget_contract: Identical backend, top-k, max steps, tool costs and context cap to ReAct controller.
agents.limitation: Must not receive evaluator support sets, state role, trigger or answer key.

optional_upgrade.activation_condition: Only after a suitable GPU and the complete 1.5B validation ladder are proven.

prerequisites: Wave R L0 and L1 pass
CPU or GPU one-model resource preflight
core Scale-1B stack already passes one-family run

checksum_policy: Pin full 40-hex repository commit before transfer.
Archive official API metadata, model card, license metadata, file allowlist and expected byte sizes.
Download into a temporary restricted directory.
Compute SHA-256 for every local file and store canonical manifest.
Atomically promote only after file set and sizes match.
Treat mirror transport as non-authoritative unless exact pinned files pass local verification.

command_templates.hf_cli: umask 077; hf download REPO_ID --revision FULL_40_HEX_COMMIT --local-dir TEMP_RESTRICTED_SNAPSHOT_DIR --include FILE_1 --include FILE_2

validation_ladder.name: import_and_offline_load
checks: independent GPU allocation check for GPU runs

validation_ladder.name: one_segment_inference
checks: SigLIP2 one frame and two queries
CLAP one ten-second waveform and two queries
SmolVLM2 fixed small frame set if enabled

validation_ladder.name: one_family_end_to_end
checks: learned retrieval, generation and both agents

requires: leakage-safe learned fusion train split and pinned coefficients
no answer or evidence labels in searchable features
Qwen 1.5B passes L0-L3 within measured limits
strict JSON and one-repair fail-closed contract
blocked and partial evidence leakage tests
ReAct and sufficiency controllers share fixed backend and budgets
distinct versioned prompts and state transitions
CLEAN BLOCKED RESTORED and no-trigger controls
typed timeout OOM malformed and over-budget failures
measured viable execution device for each model

provenance.official_metadata_source: Hugging Face model API for exact repository IDs
pending_online_or_runtime_verification: fresh metadata and license recheck immediately before download
actual model file SHA-256 after download
actual peak RAM VRAM latency and throughput
SmolVLM2 exact video sampling behavior under installed Transformers
API-only provider versioning if a local fallback is needed
